# Review

## Outcome

**Approved**

## Evidence

- All tank_core tests pass: 0 failures across 30 test binaries totaling 558+ passing tests (97 lib, 21 molt_mineral_budget, 17 reproduction_factors, 41 save_load, 24 budget_tracking, 18 validation, 23 tracing, 9 events, 6 denitrification, 33 shrimp_population, and more)
- tank_data: 33/33 pass, tank_scenarios: 5/5 pass, tank_harness: 33/33 pass (including 9 e2e_baseline_scenarios, 6 e2e_habitat_geometry_probes, 6 e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes, 3 e2e_geometry_scaling, 2 e2e_medium_planted, 2 e2e_nano_neglect)
- cargo clippy -p tank_core -p tank_data -p tank_scenarios -- -D warnings: zero warnings, cargo fmt --all --check: clean
- FR-9 amendment fr-9-3f38b0db (TAN/NO2 full-suppression defaults) VERIFIED FIXED: default_tan_repro_full_suppression_mg_n_per_l() returns 3.0 (biology.rs:1088-1091), default_no2_repro_full_suppression_mg_n_per_l() returns 1.5 (biology.rs:1097-1100), with comments documenting the preserved legacy curve shape. neocaridina_davidi.toml carries matching values (lines 61, 63). test_default_toxic_repro_full_suppression_points_preserve_legacy_span locks the contract (reproduction_factors.rs:1023-1046)
- FR-9 amendment fr-9-550c3bef (PoorCondition diagnostic consistency) VERIFIED FIXED: poor_condition_involved gated on blended condition_factor (shrimp.rs:640-641), min_condition_factor tracks the blended factor (shrimp.rs:642-643), diagnostic message at shrimp.rs:1403-1411 reports 'condition factor {blended}<{threshold} (raw {raw_condition}, reserve factor {reserve})' — no longer compares raw condition_index against blended threshold. test_reserve_driven_poor_condition_reports_blended_factor (molt_mineral_budget.rs:795-818) verifies the fix
- FR-9 amendment fr-9-f9c1063e (validation dedup) correctly REJECTED: low_temp_repro_ramp_width_c remains in both the non-negative+finiteness validation list and the strictly-positive list in ShrimpPreset::validate(), preserving the NaN/Inf guard
- All 6 acceptance criteria verified: (1) molt success depends on GH/Ca/Mg/condition/reserve/instability/thermal via mineral_modifier * condition_modifier * instability * thermal with critical_gh_deficit override, (2) 19+ named parameters on ShrimpRuntimeParams with preset/invariant support, (3) GH monotonicity + Ca/Mg contribution + condition impact unit tests pass, (4) failed molt mortality + stage-varied frequency tests pass, (5) 1000-hour soft-vs-hard integration test passes with Ca/Mg-deficient source water, (6) emit_molt_failure covers 8 cause codes (LowMinerals, HighMinerals, LowTemperature, HighTemperature, Starvation, PoorCondition, ChemistryInstability, MarginalFailure) with detail strings
- controlled_ideal_reproduction_path_still_hatches passes cleanly in e2e_baseline_scenarios, confirming the restored TAN/NO2 suppression defaults do not regress the reproduction pipeline
- All 5 shrimp scenario probes pass: successful_breeding (260 final pop, 6/6 cycles), thermal_suppression (cool vs warm differentiated), chemistry_stress (full population loss), chloride_protection (treated vs control differentiated), crash_mode (100% mortality)

## Findings and Gaps

None identified.

## Follow-up and Amendments

None.
